android.releaseNotes:
• Suppress Notifications On Logout: Background push notifications, incoming call alerts, and FCM tokens are completely deactivated and unregistered upon user signout.
• Cross-Platform Fallback Decryption: Messages sent between mobile and desktop automatically support dual-layer RSA/AES-CBC and PQ-Aura encryption.
• Chat Wallpapers & Read Delivery Status: Chat backgrounds fit uniformly with status double ticks and post-quantum badges.
